sqlMap.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'KIM_PR' AND TARGET IN ('KRYUHA0013','KRUHAN0002','KRYUHA0010','KRYUHA0011','KRYUHA0012','KRUHAN0003','KRUHAN0004') AND KEY_9 = 'N'

SELECT TARGET AS BUYER , KEY_1 AS GUBUN , KEY_2 AS ITEM_NO , KEY_3 AS ITEM_QTY , KEY_4 AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',1),' ') AS PLANT , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',2),' ') AS RD_DATE , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',3),' ') AS USER_ID1 , NVL( (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',4),' ') ) ,' ')AS USER_ID2 , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',5),' ') AS ACCOUNT_TYPE , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',6),' ') AS P_UNIT_PRICE , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',7),' ') AS ACCOUNT_CODE , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',8),' ') AS PRCTR , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',9),' ') AS PRSEG , NVL(F_SPLIT(KEY_10,'+',10),' ') AS COCTR , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME , KEY_8 AS ADD_DATM FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE TARGET IN ('KRYUHA0013','KRUHAN0002','KRYUHA0010','KRYUHA0011','KRYUHA0012','KRUHAN0003','KRUHAN0004') AND DOC_NAME = 'KIM_PR' AND KEY_9 = 'N' ORDER BY TARGET,KEY_8
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'KIM_PR' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_1 = #GUBUN# AND KEY_2 = #ITEM_NO# AND KEY_8 = #ADD_DATM# AND KEY_9 = 'N'

UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET LAST_LOGIN_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), LAST_LOGIN_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = #TARGET# AND ( USER_ID = #USER_ID2# OR LEGACY_USER_ID = #USER_ID2# )) AND COM_CODE IN ('KRYUHA0013','KRUHAN0002','KRYUHA0010','KRYUHA0011','KRYUHA0012','KRUHAN0003','KRUHAN0004')
